maxPairsPerRun.description: Maximum number of candidate source pairs evaluated by the LLM per cron or run invocation to manage latency and token usage.

bidirectional.description: Create reciprocal edges using declared inverse or symmetric relations. Unknown directional relations remain one-way.

defaultRelation.description: Fallback relation name to use if the LLM does not specify a distinct relationship type.

minLlmConfidence.description: Minimum confidence / weight score (0.0 to 1.0) from the LLM required to establish a link.

contextChunksPerSource.description: Number of recent text chunks to hydrate from each source for LLM prompt context.

maxContentChars.description: Maximum character length of content excerpt included per source in the LLM analysis prompt.

llmModel.description: Custom chat completion model name override for relationship analysis (defaults to OPENAI_CHAT_MODEL).

chatPromptTemplate.description: Custom prompt template for relationship analysis. Supports {{titleA}}, {{contentA}}, {{titleB}}, {{contentB}} placeholders.
examples: Compare {{titleA}} with {{titleB}} and output JSON with shouldLink and reason.

forceAll.description: If true, analyzes all sources across the database, ignoring updated_at watermarks.

namespace.description: Knowledge graph namespace for generated entities and edges.

enableEntityResolution.description: Resolve entity mentions and aliases shared across candidate sources into canonical graph entities.

minEntityConfidence.description: Minimum confidence required to create entity mention and coreference edges.

maxEntityResolutionsPerPair.description: Maximum grounded entity clusters retained from each source pair.

candidatesPerChunk.description: Number of matching chunks to review per source chunk.
